page.overview:
Who is Absynthe?

Absynthe, Abigail's identity as a computer program, and the Beautiful Garbage targeted Tony Stark for his accelerationware, technology capable of making programs achieve incredible speeds. During Stark's test run with his new Iron Man Armor, the Beautiful Garbage mechs attacked him with a rail gun, which penetrated his suit and incapacitated Tony. The new Iron Man's fail safe program kicked in, and a digitalized version of Stark's mind, Tony Stark 2.0 was uploaded into the suit. Via deposit by the rail gun round that penetrated the suit, Absynthe infiltrated its operating code.

Meanwhile, Absynthe had also framed Iron Man 2.0 for Stark's severe injury, so S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Capekiller unit would hunt him down. After going under the radar, before Iron Man 2.0 appeared hallucinatory images Absynthe, who showed the intention of erasing Tony Stark 2.0 from the armor's systems, and was slowly writing herself over the armor's operating code.

When Iron Man 2.0 infiltrated a Mecha Underground party with intentions of tracking down who was responsible of the attack on Stark, Absynthe hacked the different mechs at the party and attacked Iron Man 2.0. Even though he managed to exfiltrate from the scene, a S.H.I.E.L.D. Undercover Mech Intel Operative identified Iron Man, and informed the Capekiller unit of his location. As he was being targeted by S.H.I.E.L.D., Absynthe had also cracked Tony 2.0's personality construct and started overwriting his memories and programming code.

With Tony 2.0 unable to pilot the suit, it entered in tactical autopilot mode when facing S.H.I.E.L.D.'s firepower. Meanwhile, Absynthe had finally seemingly deleted Tony 2.0. However, he revealed that while Absynthe overwrote his memory space, he had simultaneously overwritten himself into her memory space. With access to Absynthe's memories, Tony 2.0 discovered her origin.
